findings.description: The `return` after `req.reject(requeue=False)` was removed. When ETA conversion raises OverflowError/ValueError, `eta` stays None and execution falls through. The request has already been rejected, but it is then reserved and passed to `handle(req)` (or rate-limited) and executed immediately. The task runs without its ETA, and the message is acked or rejected twice.
findings.title: Missing return after rejecting task with invalid ETA

findings.description: The `mark_as_failure` call was removed. A task rejected because of an unconvertible ETA no longer gets a failure state in the backend, so clients waiting on the result never see the error and may hang or see PENDING.
findings.suggestion: Restore the `req.task.backend.mark_as_failure(...)` call before rejecting, or confirm that dropping it is intended.
findings.title: Failure no longer recorded in result backend for invalid ETA
